subject: ela
intro: This test covers the whole Key Ideas and Details cluster for informational text across all three standards: answering questions with text evidence (3.RI.A.1), main idea and key details (3.RI.A.2), and describing relationships between events, ideas, or steps (3.RI.A.3). Each question is multiple choice and labeled with the standard it checks.

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

A frog has strong back legs. These legs help it jump far to catch bugs and escape danger.

WHAT do a frog's strong back legs help it do?
A) Swim in the mud
B) Jump far
C) Sing at night
D) Climb trees

steps: The question asks WHAT the legs help it do.
The passage says the legs "help it jump far."
So the answer is B.

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

Squirrels bury nuts in the fall. They dig them up in the winter when food is hard to find.

WHEN do squirrels dig up the nuts they buried?
A) In the spring
B) In the summer
C) In the winter
D) In the morning

steps: The question asks WHEN they dig up the nuts.
The passage says they "dig them up in the winter."
So the answer is C.

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

The class wanted the classroom to be cooler. They opened the windows on both sides of the room. A breeze blew through, and the room cooled down fast.

HOW did the class make the room cooler?
A) They turned off the lights
B) They opened the windows on both sides
C) They brought in fans from home
D) They closed the door
items.answer: B) They opened the windows on both sides

steps: The question asks HOW they cooled the room.
The passage says they "opened the windows on both sides," and a breeze blew through.
So the answer is B.
solution.answer: B) They opened the windows on both sides

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

Sea otters spend most of their lives in cold ocean water. Unlike many sea animals, they have no thick fat to keep warm. Instead, they have the thickest fur of any animal. They spend hours cleaning it, because trapped air in the clean fur keeps their skin warm and dry.

WHY do sea otters spend so much time cleaning their fur?
A) To look pretty for other otters
B) Because clean fur traps air that keeps them warm
C) Because they have thick fat to protect
D) To find food hidden in the fur
items.answer: B) Because clean fur traps air that keeps them warm

steps: The question asks WHY they clean their fur.
The passage says "trapped air in the clean fur keeps their skin warm and dry."
So the answer is B.
solution.answer: B) Because clean fur traps air that keeps them warm

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

Carrots are good for you. They have vitamins that help your eyes. They also give you a healthy crunch.

What is the main idea?
A) Carrots are orange
B) Carrots are good for you
C) Carrots grow in the ground
D) Rabbits like carrots
items.answer: B) Carrots are good for you

steps: Ask what the passage is mostly about.
The details tell why carrots are healthy.
So the main idea is B.
solution.answer: B) Carrots are good for you

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

Ants work together to keep their nest running. Some ants search for food and carry it home. Others dig new tunnels in the dirt. Still others guard the nest from enemies.

What is the main idea?
A) Ants are very small
B) Ants work together to keep their nest running
C) Ants like sweet food
D) Ants live in the dirt
items.answer: B) Ants work together to keep their nest running

steps: Ask what the passage is mostly about.
Each detail names a job ants do together for the nest.
So the main idea is B, not one small detail.
solution.answer: B) Ants work together to keep their nest running

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

Rivers have shaped how people live for thousands of years. People settle near rivers to get fresh water to drink. They use the water to grow crops in nearby fields. They also travel and carry goods on boats along the river.

Which detail supports the idea that rivers help people grow food?
A) People travel on boats along the river
B) People use the water to grow crops in nearby fields
C) Rivers are thousands of years old
D) People drink fresh water
items.answer: B) People use the water to grow crops in nearby fields

steps: Find the detail about growing food.
The passage says people "use the water to grow crops in nearby fields."
So the answer is B.
solution.answer: B) People use the water to grow crops in nearby fields

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

Many people think bats are scary pests, but bats are helpful friends to farmers. A single bat can eat thousands of insects in one night, including the bugs that harm crops. Bats also help plants grow by spreading seeds and pollen as they fly. Without bats, farmers would have a much harder time.

Which sentence best states the main idea of the whole passage?
A) Bats fly at night
B) Bats are helpful friends to farmers
C) Bats eat insects
D) Some people think bats are scary
items.answer: B) Bats are helpful friends to farmers

steps: The main idea must cover the whole passage.
The details show how bats help farmers by eating pests and spreading seeds.
Choices A and C are single details, so the best answer is B.
solution.answer: B) Bats are helpful friends to farmers

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

First, the traffic light turned red. So the cars stopped. Then the people crossed the street.

WHY did the cars stop?
A) Because a dog ran by
B) Because the light turned red
C) Because it was raining
D) Because the road was closed
items.answer: B) Because the light turned red

steps: The word "So" points to the cause.
The passage says, "First, the traffic light turned red. So the cars stopped."
So the answer is B.
solution.answer: B) Because the light turned red

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

To grow a sunflower, follow the steps in order. First, plant the seed in soil. Next, water it and give it sunlight. Then wait as a green stem grows tall. Finally, a big yellow flower opens at the top.

What happens right after you plant the seed in soil?
A) A yellow flower opens
B) You water it and give it sunlight
C) The stem grows tall
D) You pick the flower
items.answer: B) You water it and give it sunlight

steps: Follow the order words: first, next, then, finally.
After planting the seed, "Next, water it and give it sunlight."
So the answer is B.
solution.answer: B) You water it and give it sunlight

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

The town had a problem with muddy paths after every rain. Because the bare dirt turned to mud, people slipped and got dirty. So the town spread wood chips over the paths. As a result, the paths stayed firm and dry even after a storm.

Which sentence best describes the relationship between the wood chips and the dry paths?
A) The rain made the wood chips grow
B) The wood chips covered the mud, so the paths stayed firm and dry
C) The paths were dry before the wood chips
D) The mud made the town spread more rain
items.answer: B) The wood chips covered the mud, so the paths stayed firm and dry

steps: Follow the cause and effect chain.
The town "spread wood chips over the paths," and "as a result, the paths stayed firm and dry."
So the answer is B.
solution.answer: B) The wood chips covered the mud, so the paths stayed firm and dry

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

Long ago, a huge chunk of ice called a glacier slowly moved across the land. First, the heavy ice scraped over the rock as it crept along. Then, because the ice was so heavy, it carved a deep valley into the ground. Finally, when the weather warmed, the ice melted and filled the valley with water, forming a lake.

Which answer correctly describes how the lake was formed?
A) The lake was there before the glacier
B) The heavy ice carved a valley, and when it melted, water filled the valley to form a lake
C) The rock pushed the ice into a lake
D) The warm weather froze the valley into ice
items.answer: B) The heavy ice carved a valley, and when it melted, water filled the valley to form a lake

steps: Follow the sequence and cause words: first, then, because, finally.
The heavy ice "carved a deep valley," and then "the ice melted and filled the valley with water."
So the answer is B.
solution.answer: B) The heavy ice carved a valley, and when it melted, water filled the valley to form a lake
